messages:
amina-csm: Flagging ~95 impacted tenants across EMEA/APAC; ~20 in <60d renewal window. Proposal: localized short comms + 30-45m remediation slots, recorded replay, and targeted goodwill credits. Need quick sign-off on cadence and customer-facing wording.

drew-cs: Agree. Keep email concise and calm: lead with 'No action required if search looks normal.' Offer 'Request 1:1' for at-risk renewals. Provide calendar in CET/SGT.

leo-eng: Tech note: ingestion lag caused by backfill queue race during deploy. Mitigated; no vectors lost. Recommend we tell customers NOT to re-run full ingests unless support advises. I'll give a 1-line diagnostic to include.

sara-ops: Ops can run office hours next week: EMEA 14:00 CET (45m) M/W/F; APAC 09:30 SGT (30m) T/Th. We'll auto-open a support ticket when a customer clicks 'Request 1:1'.

amina-csm (draft): "Hi <Customer>,
We experienced a temporary onboarding delay that affected embedding indexing for a subset of tenants. Engineers mitigated the issue and we have not observed data loss.
If your search results look normal, no action required. If you see missing results, please schedule a short remediation slot here: <cal_link>. We also offer a goodwill credit for impacted customers in renewal windows and a recorded replay in your language.
Thanks, Amina (Customer Success)"

drew-cs: Add a short FAQ line: "We do not recommend reindexing unless you see missing vectors or mismatched results." Add a tiny diagnostic snippet customers can run.

leo-eng: Snippet: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/<index>/count`

sara-ops: Action items: 1) amina finalize email + calendar link by EOD; 2) drew prepare localized EN/FR/DE/JP short copy; 3) leo verify diagnostic endpoint and sign-off; 4) ops to tag and prioritize <60d renewals for 1:1 outreach.

status-bot: Support group INC-ONBOARD-2024 created and linked to thread.

amina-csm: Plan to send first wave to <60d cohort 08:00 CET tomorrow. We'll collect a 2-question post-session survey and reconvene after the first wave to set credit bands and any handoffs."
